turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40. Why was my son's mark changed before anyone called me?
The checker said 94 percent. That's the end of it.
The company that sells that checker says it shouldn't be the only basis for acting against a student. So what else do you have, Hale, or is that it?
I don't need more proof than that.

"Don't need." Your own procedure says software alone doesn't establish a concern, and it says you contact me before any mark is entered. Nobody called me, Hale, so I'm writing down that you decided first, and I'll be asking the principal who else signed off.
The software doesn't lie, unlike some people.
"Unlike some people." My child never lies, so who are you talking about, Hale? Are you calling me a liar?
"Stands" on what, Hale? A score from software, no document, and a procedure you didn't follow. I'm writing down that you refused to withdraw it, and the principal is my next stop.
